newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL shares end mixed on selective blue-chip buying.
newsitem.headline: KL shares end mixed on selective blue-chip buying.

text.p: Malaysian equities closed mixed with blue chips up on selective late buying activity, dealers said.
"The Composite Index was almost flat for almost the whole day," said a trader at an institutional brokerage.
The Composite Index of 100 large-capitalised stocks closed up 2.24 points to 1194.40, while the small-cap Second Board index closed down 7.15 to 647.43.
Tenaga was unchanged at 11.10, while Telekom was up 30 at 23.10.
"Local and foreign institutions were buying Tenaga and Telekom, but there was hardly any spillover into the rest of the market," said the trader.
"There is an improving outlook for both these heavyweights after recent uncertainties have been dispelled," he added.
Farlim was up 1.05 ringgit to 6.90, with 10.5 million shares traded, making it the most active stock of the day.

"Farlim is a low-cost property construction specialist, and there has been speculation of a possible takeover or a substantial land acquisition by the company," said Faez Khairrudin, head of research at SJ Securities.
